EXPLORER.name: Explorer
EXPLORER.tagline: Goes first and finds the way.
EXPLORER.description: Earns the most XP for exploring: new roads and new tiles pay best.

WIZARD.name: Wizard
WIZARD.tagline: Reads the runes and looks twice.
WIZARD.description: Earns the most XP for finding places and finishing quests, and is best with runes.

WARRIOR.name: Warrior
WARRIOR.tagline: Goes the distance and takes the hill.
WARRIOR.description: Earns the most XP for distance and climbing, measured against yourself and nobody else.

SCRIBE.name: Scribe
SCRIBE.tagline: Stops, looks and writes it down.
SCRIBE.description: Earns the most XP for finding places and quest objectives, and is best with notes.
SCRIBE.saying: It may as well be you.
